Senior Backend Engineer — SkillMatch Platform (Remote / Cairo, Egypt)

About the Role
We are looking for a Senior Backend Engineer to join our core platform team. You will
design and build the APIs, data pipelines, and infrastructure that power our AI-driven
job-matching service for hundreds of thousands of users.

Requirements (Must Have)
- 5+ years of professional backend engineering experience
- Strong proficiency in Python (FastAPI or Django)
- Deep expertise in PostgreSQL and query optimization
- Experience designing RESTful APIs at scale
- Solid understanding of Docker and containerized deployment
- Proficiency in Redis for caching and async task queues
- Strong knowledge of Git and CI/CD pipelines

Nice to Have
- Familiarity with Kubernetes and Helm charts
- Exposure to Celery for distributed task processing
- Experience with AWS or GCP cloud services
- Knowledge of GraphQL

Responsibilities
- Design and implement high-performance backend APIs using FastAPI
- Lead code reviews and enforce engineering best practices across the team
- Optimize database schemas and queries for throughput and latency
- Collaborate with ML engineers to integrate AI models into the platform
- Write comprehensive unit and integration tests

Experience
The ideal candidate has 5-8 years of hands-on backend engineering experience in
production systems handling millions of requests per day.

Location & Constraints
- Position is remote-first with optional office access in Cairo, Egypt
- Must have a valid work permit if located outside Egypt
- Fluent English is required for daily communication with international stakeholders
